title.zh: 被持有的生命上 G0 就是立场中立：每个活的主张都被某个立场持有时，G0 恰等于每个立场的 S0 加 N_std，不需要连通与 N_rel；中心不由动力学推出
title.en: On held lives G0 is standpoint neutrality: where every living claim is held by some standpoint, G0 is exactly S0 at every standpoint with N_std, needing neither connection nor N_rel; the center is not derived from the dynamics

claim.zh: 在估值上，一个活的主张在某个立场的自身区域中，称为被持有；每个活的主张都被持有，记为 Valuation.Held，无人持有的主张记为 Valuation.Unheld。每个活的主张都被持有时，G0（主张层面：每个活的主张从每个立场都有意义）恰等于每个立场的 S0 加立场中立 N_std，既不用连通，也不用 N_rel（Valuation.significant_iff_held）。持有可判定、每个活的主张都经已形成的关系从一个被持有的活的主张到达时，G0 恰等于每个立场的 S0、N_std 与只指向无人持有者的 N_rel（Valuation.significant_iff_reached）。三者都必要：每个生命都被持有、只被自己的立场珍视时 S0 处处成立而 N_std 与 G0 不成立（Apart.standpoint_neutrality_is_needed）；一个无人持有的生命在 S0 与 N_std 之下没有意义（Unclaimed.held_is_needed）；从被持有者到达而无人持有的生命，在 S0 与 N_std 之下没有意义，指向无人持有者的 N_rel 不成立（Relayed.transmission_is_needed）。逐步读、每个形成以自身的事件为自身区域时，每个活的事件都被持有（Web.held_by_formations），所以 G0 恰等于每个形成的 S0 加 N_std（Web.significant_iff_self）。中心不由动力学推出：derived-extent-limits 的谨慎照管者满足每项推出的要求，从各形成自身的立场、以各自的事件评价时，每个生命都被持有，S0 处处成立，意义传入各自区域也成立，而另一个形成在第零步的活的事件从照管者的立场没有意义，N_std 与 G0 不成立（Totalizer.center_not_derived）；加上 N_std，G0 由 Web.significant_iff_self 成立。不用伦理公理，也不用 Lean 公理：S0、N_std 与 N_rel 都是定理的假设。
claim.en: On a valuation, a living claim is held when it lies in the own region of some standpoint; every living claim being held is Valuation.Held, and a claim no standpoint holds is Valuation.Unheld. Where every living claim is held, G0 at the level of claims (every living claim significant from every standpoint) is exactly S0 at every standpoint with standpoint neutrality N_std, using neither connection nor N_rel (Valuation.significant_iff_held). With holding decided and every living claim reached through formed relations from a held living claim, G0 is exactly S0 at every standpoint, N_std, and N_rel into claims no standpoint holds (Valuation.significant_iff_reached). Each is needed: with every life held and valued by its own standpoint only, S0 holds everywhere while N_std and G0 fail (Apart.standpoint_neutrality_is_needed); a life no standpoint holds has no significance under S0 and N_std (Unclaimed.held_is_needed); a life reached from a held one that no standpoint holds has no significance under S0 and N_std, N_rel into unheld claims failing (Relayed.transmission_is_needed). Read stepwise with each formation a standpoint whose own region is its own events, every living event is held (Web.held_by_formations), so G0 is exactly S0 at every formation with N_std (Web.significant_iff_self). The center is not derived from the dynamics: the careful keeper of derived-extent-limits meets every derived requirement, and valued from each formation's own standpoint over its own events every life is held, S0 holds everywhere and transmission into each own region holds, while the other formation's living event at step zero has no significance from the keeper's standpoint, so N_std and G0 fail (Totalizer.center_not_derived); with N_std added, G0 holds by Web.significant_iff_self. No ethical axiom and no Lean axiom is used: S0, N_std and N_rel are hypotheses of the theorems.

hypotheses.zh: 持有：每个活的主张在某个立场的自身区域中；这是对应的前提。把 Ren 提议中的“想要自身延续者”读作持有、把 S0 读作想要，是 AI 提出、待 Ren 判断的读法。
hypotheses.en: Holding: every living claim lies in some standpoint's own region, a correspondence premise. Reading ‘anything that wants its continuation’ as holding and S0 as wanting is the AI's proposed reading, for Ren to judge.

hypotheses.zh: significant_iff_reached 需要持有可判定，是表示的逻辑承诺，同可判定相等。
hypotheses.en: significant_iff_reached needs holding to be decided, a logical commitment of the representation, as decided equality is.

hypotheses.zh: S0、N_std 与 N_rel 都是假设，不是证明了的前提；本结果说 G0 在被持有的生命上恰等于哪些前提，不证明它们。
hypotheses.en: S0, N_std and N_rel are hypotheses, not proved premises; the result says exactly which premises G0 amounts to on held lives and proves none of them.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说：“it can be anything that want's its continuation to have significance”，又说：“if we want to add one axiom, that is for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”。AI 把它分为两半，Ren 答“exactly”：动力学定出想要延续者必须计入的范围，定不出中心；那条公理的唯一作用是让每一点都是中心。本结果给出中心一半的形式内容：对被持有的生命，那条公理恰是 N_std，S0 是每个想要的点上的种子；连通与 N_rel 只对无人持有的生命还有作用。与 metaethical-core-characterization 的关系：那里从一个种子出发，需要连通与 N_rel；这里在每个想要的点都有种子，只需要 N_std。在连通且每个生命都被持有的整体上二者都等价于 G0；一般地互不蕴涵，原刻画保持其范围。self-good-reachable-g0 留下了从立场相对的意义到规范意义的桥；重述把这座桥命名为唯一公理。对手的形状不变：主要的对手接受处处 S0，把意义限在各自的立场之内（Apart），这正是那条公理所否认的边界。在 Ren 接受重述之前，G0 仍是采用的公理。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says “it can be anything that want's its continuation to have significance” and “if we want to add one axiom, that is for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”. The AI analysis, which Ren answered “exactly”, splits it in two halves: the dynamics fixes the extent of what a wanting formation must count, not its center; the axiom's one job is to put a center at every point. This result gives the formal content of the center: on held lives the axiom is exactly N_std, S0 being the seed at every wanting point; connection and N_rel keep a role only for lives no standpoint holds. Relation to metaethical-core-characterization: that route starts from one seed and needs connection and N_rel; this one seeds every wanting point and needs only N_std. Where the whole is connected and every life is held both are equivalent to G0; in general neither implies the other, and the earlier characterization keeps its scope. self-good-reachable-g0 left a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance; the restatement names that bridge as the one axiom. The shape of rivals persists: the principal rival accepts S0 everywhere and keeps significance within each standpoint (Apart), the boundary the axiom denies. Until Ren accepts the restatement G0 remains the adopted axiom.

detail.zh: 复用 Valuation、SelfGood、transmits、shares、Neutral、Within、Significant、Reach 与 Invariant.reach；原刻画 significant_iff 保持其范围。
detail.en: Reuses Valuation, SelfGood, transmits, shares, Neutral, Within, Significant, Reach and Invariant.reach; the earlier characterization significant_iff keeps its scope.

output.zh: 估值、S0、两条中立与 G0 的定义；沿关系的不变量。
output.en: The valuation, S0, the two neutralities and G0; invariants along relations.

input.zh: 被持有的生命上 G0 恰等于处处 S0 加 N_std。
input.en: On held lives G0 is exactly S0 everywhere with N_std.

conditions.zh: 持有；significant_iff_reached 另需持有可判定与到达。
conditions.en: Holding; significant_iff_reached also needs decided holding and reach.

detail.zh: 复用逐步读法的估值 Web.valuation（living：活跃且不侵蚀；related：共同参与）。
detail.en: Reuses the stepwise valuation Web.valuation (living: active and not undermining; related: co-participation).

output.en: The stepwise valuation of a web.

input.zh: 每个形成以自身事件为自身区域时，每个活的事件都被持有。
input.en: With each formation's own events its own region, every living event is held.

detail.zh: 中心不由动力学推出的见证使用谨慎照管者，它满足联合地在所给之内（WithinJoint）。
detail.en: The witness that the center is not derived uses the careful keeper, which takes jointly within what is given (WithinJoint).

output.zh: 联合地在所给之内的定义。
output.en: Taking jointly within what is given.

input.zh: 满足它的照管者仍不使 N_std 成立。
input.en: A keeper meeting it still does not make N_std hold.

detail.zh: 那里留下了从立场相对的意义到规范意义的桥；这里说明在被持有的生命上，G0 超出 S0 的恰是 N_std。
detail.en: It left a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance; here, on held lives, what G0 adds beyond S0 is exactly N_std.

detail.zh: 谨慎的照管者是中心不由动力学推出的见证。
detail.en: The careful keeper is the witness that the center is not derived.

detail.zh: 连通与 N_rel 的读法只对无人持有的生命仍有作用。
detail.en: Readings of connection and N_rel keep a role only for lives no standpoint holds.

detail.zh: 每个前提都必要：Apart（每个生命都被持有、只被自己的立场珍视）、Unclaimed（无人持有的生命）、Relayed（被到达而无人持有的生命）。
detail.en: Each premise is needed: Apart (every life held and valued by its own standpoint only), Unclaimed (a life no standpoint holds), Relayed (a reached life no standpoint holds).
The center is not derived from the dynamics: Totalizer.center_not_derived.

limitations.zh: 不证明 S0、N_std 或 N_rel，不约束拒绝它们的立场，不推出义务、排序、认识或遵循；持有是对应前提，哪些形成想要、“想要”是否即 S0 由 Ren 判断；无人持有的生命（休眠的种子、昏迷、不再想继续的人）是否在公理的范围内由 Ren 选择；只陈述主张层面的 G0；重述是否替代 G0 由 Ren 定，在此之前 G0 仍是采用的公理；名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定（Held、Unheld、Apart、Unclaimed、Relayed 等）。
limitations.en: Proves none of S0, N_std or N_rel, binds no rejecting standpoint, and infers no duty, ranking, recognition or compliance; holding is a correspondence premise, and which formations want, and whether wanting is S0, are for Ren to judge; whether lives no standpoint holds (a dormant seed, a coma, someone who no longer wants to go on) are within the axiom's range is Ren's choice; states G0 at the level of claims only; whether the restatement replaces G0 is Ren's decision, and until then G0 remains the adopted axiom; the names are the AI's wording, for Ren to choose (Held, Unheld, Apart, Unclaimed, Relayed and others).

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261009T222752.438253Z）：Becoming.Standpoints 的 17 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 29 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 1280 项定理／2062 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261009T223112.652163Z 通过。作者反审见整合文档 §47，尚无独立反审。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 31 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261009T222752.438253Z): the 17 theorems of Becoming.Standpoints all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 29 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 1280 theorems/2062 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261009T223112.652163Z passed. The author's counterreview is in §47 of the integration note; no independent review yet. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 31 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: Ren 的判断：S0 是否即想要、公理的范围、伤害的层级、重述是否替代 G0；N_std 的哲学根据；整段读法与关系层上的同一形式；与 universal_reason 的接通。
next_delta.en: Ren's judgments: whether S0 is wanting, the axiom's range, the level of harm, whether the restatement replaces G0; the philosophical ground of N_std; the same form on the whole-run reading and at the level of relations; connecting to universal_reason.
